rationale: Identity: the held original (30 FR 11129, Aug. 26, 1965) is Executive Order 11241, which amends subparagraphs (3) and (4) of 32 CFR 1631.7(a), effective on its own date; the amendment was performed on issue. In the held EO 11497 text (34 FR 19019), item 3 revokes paragraphs (a) and (b) of section 1631.7 and prescribes a new paragraph (a), which removed the text 11241 inserted. The held EO 12553 text (51 FR 7237) revokes the listed orders 'and any amendments thereto' and lists '11241 Amending Selective Service regulations' on PDF page 12. I found no saving clause in either order. Provisional no is supported; the ending is at the latest February 25, 1986.
